Aim: Explore Matplotlib and make various visualizations:  
P r a c t i c a l :  3  
•  C r e a t e  B a r  C h a r t s  a n d  P i e  C h a r t s  
•  G e n e r a t e  a  H i s t o g r a m  t o  V i s u a l i z e  t h e  D i s t r i b u t i o n  o f  D a t a  
•  C r e a t e  B o x  P l o t s  t o  U n d e r s t a n d  D a t a  S p r e a d  a n d  I d e n t i f y  O u t l i e r s
•  C r e a t e  h e a t  m a p s  f r o m  V i s u a l i z e  t h e  c o r r e l a t i o n  o f  D a t a  
Code:  
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  
import numpy as np  
# Bar Chart  
x = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]  
y = [2, 5, 3, 8, 7]  
plt.bar(x, y)  
plt.title("Profit Analysis")  
plt.xlabel("Months")  
plt.ylabel("Profit")  
plt.show()  
# Pie Chart  
subjects = ["python", "java", "c", "javascript"]  
students = [30, 25, 20, 25]  
plt.pie(students, labels=subjects, autopct="%0.1f%%")  
plt.title("Students Learning Programming Languages")  
plt.show()  
# Histogram  
ages = [18, 19, 20, 20, 21, 21, 22, 22, 22, 23, 24, 24, 25, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29]
plt.hist(ages, bins=12)  
plt.title("Age Distribution")  
plt.xlabel("Age")  
plt.ylabel("Frequency")  
plt.show()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  
import numpy as np  
# Bar Chart  
x = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]  
y = [2, 5, 3, 8, 7]  
plt.bar(x, y)  
plt.title("Profit Analysis")  
plt.xlabel("Months")  
plt.ylabel("Profit")  
plt.show()  
# Pie Chart  
subjects = ["python", "java", "c", "javascript"]  
students = [30, 25, 20, 25]  
plt.pie(students, labels=subjects, autopct="%0.1f%%")  
plt.title("Students Learning Programming Languages")  
plt.show()  
# Histogram  
ages = [18, 19, 20, 20, 21, 21, 22, 22, 22, 23, 24, 24, 25, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29]
plt.hist(ages, bins=12)  
plt.title("Age Distribution")  
plt.xlabel("Age")  
plt.ylabel("Frequency")  
plt.show()

#Box Plot  
plt.boxplot(ages, patch_artist=True)
plt.title("Age Distribution - Box Plot")
plt.ylabel("Age")  
plt.show()  
#Heat Map  
data = np.array([  
[10, 20, 30],  
[40, 50, 60],  
[70, 80, 90]  
])  
plt.imshow(data, cmap="hot")
plt.colorbar()
plt.title("Heatmap")
plt.show()
